presentation.label: SCENE MORPH
presentation.summary: Lock MIDI track parameters to scenes and morph them with the crossfader.
presentation.overview: MIDI Scenes brings scene locks to MIDI tracks. Hold a scene and edit MIDI parameters, then morph between scenes with the crossfader. Locks follow Part and project save/reload and scene clear, copy and paste. MIDISC2.0 also activates scenes before the first trig, lands changes on the real pattern/Part boundary, holds unscened live locks across refresh, sends CC before notes, and follows the playing pattern's Part as soon as the sequencer commits ACT.
highlights: Scene A/B locks on MIDI tracks
Crossfader morphing with step parameter locks
Pre-trig scenes / XF; pattern-commit Part sync (MIDISC2.0)
usage: Hold scene A or B and turn a MIDI track parameter to create its scene lock. The lock indicator shows which scene holds values.
Move the crossfader to morph between the two sides. An empty side uses a trig lock when present, otherwise the underlying track value.

Use the scene clear, copy and paste actions and Part Save/Reload. Pattern changes update MIDI scenes with the new pattern's Part at sequencer commit. The upstream MIDI CONTROL CC48/55/56 filtering options are disabled.

limitations: Firmware builds for this module version are awaiting Octamod verification (relocatable MIDISC2.0 port pending).
Octamod native units remain the relocatable 8.2-derived gas pin; standalone MIDISC2.0 documentation is vendored separately.
MIDI CONTROL CC48/55/56 filter rows are not included.
Composition with Octakit requires its KITS RELOAD bridge; Octakit is outside this catalog.
